caption: The drawing depicts two views of a straight razor with a folding mechanism. The handle of the razor is predominantly a light tan color with irregular darker brownish-orange stripes or bands running diagonally along its length, creating a patterned appearance. Each handle appears to have a circular rivet near the top, indicating the pivot point for the blade. One razor is shown open, with its long, narrow, silver metallic blade extended and aligned horizontally. The other razor is shown in a partially closed position with the blade partially folded into the handle, and the hooked tang of the blade visible protruding above the handle. The blades have a smooth, reflective look and maintain a consistent width. A small scale drawing appears in the lower left corner, indicating the dimensions of the object, and text is present in the bottom right corner with the name "Gordon Saltar Del 156-1."
title: Quill Sharpener Knife
